articles.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon as Hezbollah condemns new deal
articles.description: Strikes have killed at least one person, state media say a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement.

articles.title: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
articles.description: Iran accuses the US of violating their deal and says it struck targets linked to American forces in response.

articles.title: DR Congo takes Rwanda to international court over decades of conflict
articles.description: Kinshasa accuses its neighbour of committing various violations since the 1994 Rwanda genocide.
